news_title: CFS urges public not to consume batch of imported ready-to-eat turkey meat product due to possible temperature abuse - www.info.gov.hk
efet_title: Food Alerts / Allergy Alerts - Not to consume batch of imported ready-to-eat turkey meat product due to possible temperature abuse
efet_body:
Not to consume batch of imported ready-to-eat turkey meat product due to possible temperature abuse
Issue Date
21.10.2026
Source of Information
Food Incident Surveillance System of the Centre for Food Safety
Food Product
Ready-to-eat turkey meat product
Product Name and Description
Product name: Oil Braised Oven Roasted Turkey Breast
Brand: Mckenzie
Place of origin: US
Batch number: 26175
Best before date: 7 September, 2027
Importer: Etak International Limited
Reason For Issuing Alert
The Centre for Food Safety (CFS), through its Food Incident Surveillance System, noted a notification from the US authorities that the above-mentioned product is being recalled as it might have undergone possible temperature abuse during storage.
Upon learning of the incident, the CFS immediately contacted local importers and retailers to follow up. A preliminary investigation found that the above-mentioned importer had imported into Hong Kong the affected batch of the product concerned.
If meat and poultry products are subjected to temperature abuse during storage, this can facilitate the growth of foodborne pathogens or lead to spoilage. Infected individuals with foodborne pathogens may experience symptoms such as fever, abdominal cramps, vomiting, and diarrhoea. However, severe complications may occur in newborns, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals.
Action Taken by the Centre for Food Safety
The importer concerned has stopped sales, removed from shelves the affected batch of the product, and initiated a recall according to the CFS's instructions.
The CFS will continue to follow up on the incident and take appropriate action to safeguard food safety and public health. The investigation is ongoing.
Advice to the Trade
Stop using or selling the affected batch of the product immediately if they possess it.
Advice to Consumers
Stop consuming the affected batch of the product and seek medical treatment as soon as possible if they feel unwell after consuming the product concerned.
Further Information
The CFS press release
Members of the public may call the importer’s hotline at 2526 2371 during office hours for enquiries about the recall.
